what: Greedy sampling no longer sorts the whole vocabulary
harness: tools/ab_runner.py, generate --temp 0 --seed 1, 247-token prompt, 32 tokens, frozen plans in docs/benchmarks/sampler-greedy-20260920
candidate: same tree with the sampler change
cause: sample() built a 151936-element pair array and std::sort'd it before the temp<=0 branch read element zero
reading: The saved work is a constant per token, about 7 ms, so it is a large share of a 0.6B token and a small share of an 8B one. The 8B cells sit inside the runner's 3% noise band at five pairs and are reported as unresolved, not as a win.
not_measured: The temp>0 path also changed (partial_sort over the top-k window instead of a full sort) and was not benchmarked; the A/B used temperature zero.
scope: The matched mx-llama.cpp gate is unaffected: tools/compare_cpu.py times model inference only and excludes sampling.
